name: Flax Farm linseed oil
note: Flax Farm unrefined linseed oil (flaxfarm.co.uk), label per 100 ml: 835 kcal, fat 92.7 g (saturates 9.2, mono 13.9, poly 69.6 g), omega-3 58.2 g (the label prints 8.7 g per 100 ml and 58.2 g per 15 ml - the columns are swapped), salt 0. Converted to per 100 g at 0.93 g/ml; linoleic acid = polyunsaturates - omega-3. The omega-3 is ALA, which dogs convert poorly to EPA/DHA, so EPA+DHA = 0 - it does not replace fish or algal oil. Vitamins/minerals not on the label: taken from the generic linseed oil entry (USDA/AFCD). Keep refrigerated; do not cook or bake.
